name: FemiCore
description: FemiCore is a once-daily capsule marketed as a women's bladder and urinary support supplement. Per its listing it combines a 350 mg herbal blend with a 50 mg five-strain Lactobacillus probiotic blend.
features: Herbal blend: mimosa pudica seed, cranberry extract, bearberry leaf, berberine
Non-GMO, no stimulants, made in the USA (per listing)
pros: Refund policy offered by the seller
No autoship per the listing (verify at checkout)
cons: Results vary; no supplement is a substitute for medical care
Independent clinical evidence for the formula not verified here
Bladder or urinary symptoms should be checked by a doctor first

name: NeuroPrime
description: NeuroPrime is a liquid-drop supplement marketed for memory support. Its listing names nine plant ingredients and offers a 365-day refund guarantee.
features: Ingredients: moringa, pine bark extract, ginkgo biloba, tamarind, lion's mane, chlorella, bacopa monnieri, spirulina, neem
Liquid drops, one serving per day per the listing
pros: Long refund window offered by the seller
Multi-bottle discounts and free shipping on larger orders
cons: The listing's cited studies mostly concern melatonin, which is not in the ingredient list
Evidence for the specific formula is not shown on the product page
Bulk pricing means a large upfront cost; consider the one-bottle option first
Talk to a doctor before use, especially with medication or a medical condition
